layout: row-major; x increases within rows; z increases between rows (north to south)

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / SRTM
source.attribution: Mapzen. SRTM data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
source.encoding: Terrarium RGB; metres = R * 256 + G + B / 256 - 32768
source.resampling: bilinear from source pixel centres to museum world X/Z grid
source.quantization: nearest 0.1 metre, ties to even; unsigned 16-bit values

displayGuidance.note: Visual museum adaptation; runtime applies edge fades and protects engineered sites, transport and water. Not a surveying model.
